solution.brief: Use Wasp_Get Part Geometry to extract placed geometry from aggregation PART_OUT for visualization via Custom Preview.
solution.principle: After running a Wasp aggregation, parts exist as abstract WaspPart objects with position/orientation data; PartGeo extracts and transforms the underlying geometry to each part's world-space placement, making it accessible for standard GH visualization and processing workflows.

intents: how do I visualize wasp aggregation results
see the placed parts from stochastic aggregation
get mesh or brep from wasp part objects
symptoms: PART_OUT from aggregation is not directly previewable or shows no geometry
need to apply materials or colors to aggregated parts
aggregation runs but geometry is invisible in viewport
want to post-process or analyze placed part geometry

preconditions: Wasp_Stochastic Aggregation (or similar) has been run and produces PART_OUT
PART_OUT contains valid WaspPart objects (aggregation has placed at least one part)
Wasp plugin is installed and loaded in Grasshopper
